paper_title: First results of axion dark matter search with DANCE
notes: DANCE Act-1 polarization-based optical cavity axion DM search. The paper reports a 95% CL upper limit g_agamma <~ 8e-4 GeV^-1 over the mass range 1e-14 eV < m_a < 1e-13 eV.
